runtime.promotionBlocker: Keep v2 in shadow mode until another crisis or a genuinely unseen time period confirms it; all reported uncertainty intervals cross zero.

targetDefinition: Cross 15% below the recent 252-session high within 63 trading days

currentScore.note: Probability levels are model-dependent; a lower v2 number is not itself evidence of a safer market.

knownLimitations: The 2016-2025 baseline result was already known before this challenger study, so this is not a pristine blind holdout from the researcher's perspective.
The candidate itself was selected using only data before the strict 2016 boundary.
Only four distinct crisis crossings occur in the holdout; confidence intervals remain wide.
The mapper is mildly non-monotonic at extreme raw scores, which improves this sample but can be unstable under regime change.
It still misses the abrupt March 2020 COVID crossing.
